content:
To conﬁgure capacity settings in the OpenSearch Serverless console, expand Serverless in the left
navigation pane and select Dashboard. Specify the maximum indexing and search capacity under
Capacity management:
To conﬁgure capacity using the AWS CLI, send an UpdateAccountSettings request:
aws opensearchserverless update-account-settings \
--capacity-limits '{ "maxIndexingCapacityInOCU": 8,"maxSearchCapacityInOCU": 9 }'

hierarchy.parent: Managing capacity limits for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
